input.subject: Jinbe
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Whale-shark fish-man, Fish-Man Karate/Jujutsu, water-particle shock and water throws, Armament and Observation. No Devil Fruit or invented transformation. Karate works on dry land through ambient/body water; Jujutsu water movement needs a bounded authored representation, no arbitrary target teleport. Helmsmanship alone is not magical ally range. Preserve measured displacement, armor pressure and reliable contact with actual named attacks. Use the attached fresh campaign research and generate a new candidate, with no prior candidate supplied. Preserve the whale-shark appearance and recognizable named moves from the actual researched technique pages: distinguish Karakusagawara Seiken atmospheric-water shockwave, Samegawara Seiken body-water force punch, and Soshark crushing grip. Include their distinct supported behavior where the runtime allows, explaining any contextual Technique replacement. Buraikan and Armament should remain recognizable. Water throws require supplied environmental water: if the contract cannot enforce that condition, omit that action explicitly rather than imply self-generated water. Kairagi is a defensive block, never an invented hostile attack. No fake helmsman ally range buff, no fabricated research-unavailable boilerplate. Exact Wano cutoff excludes chapter 1058 bounty and later moves. Keep root description below 1800 characters; put further lifecycle explanations in relevant descriptions. All purchases concrete and executable, with distinct playstyles rather than repetitive generic damage paths. Numerical tuning is provisional pending actual encounter comparisons.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

knowledge.subject: Jinbe
gaps: All five supplied captures were read through their ends, including later technique sections, references and navigation. Each reports acquisitionTruncated=false. Linked manga chapters, images and external pages were not independently inspected; citations identify only the supplied sources.

The requested continuity is supported, but the wiki pages are not snapshots restricted to Wano. The cutoff is treated as the Wano conclusion and departure, not subsequent revelations. The 1,100,000,000 bounty and associated senior-officer presentation cite Chapter 1058, explicitly described by the source as post-Wano, and are not adopted as cutoff facts.

Excluded post-Wano techniques: Gosenmaigawara Shuto / Five Thousand Brick Chop (Chapter 1111), Kata Guruma / Piggyback (Chapter 1117), and Umigumo Ipponzeoi / Sea Cloud Shoulder Throw (Chapter 1145). Their presence in later sections was checked, not overlooked.
The marine-life ability is supported before Wano, but its name Shark Network / Same Joho mo is sourced to Chapter 1130 and is not adopted as an in-scope named technique.

Excluded later material includes Egghead and Elbaph outfits, Bonney-induced childhood reversion, S-Shark's separate abilities, the Mecha-Shark rescue, and Observation Haki examples involving Saturn, Mars and the alleged Chapter 1189 Luffy–Imu battle. The latter allegation is not independently verified and is outside scope regardless.

No named combat transformation for Jinbe within the requested cutoff is established by these pages. Armament hardening is recorded as Haki rather than invented as a transformation. Other characters' hybrid forms, Energy Steroid changes and Devil Fruit powers are not Jinbe's.

Excluded non-manga or game-specific Jinbe techniques include Shizurase, Dai Kairyu Keri, Kairyu Shibuki Hashira, and game-only uses of Senmaigawara Seiken, Yabusame and Jujutsu Murasame / Shark Pack. Jinbe's manga Murasame / Rain Shower is a different technique from Hody's shark-shaped Jujutsu Murasame.

Anime-only presentations were not merged into manga techniques, including Gosenmaigawara Seiken's immediate shockwave and different Jailer Beast target, Yarinami's whirlpool staging, and Mizugokoro's glowing orb.

The main page's Quick Answers inconsistently calls Jinbe the ninth member and gives Whole Cake Island as the joining point. The detailed main text distinguishes ninth recruit/tenth member and formal Wano arrival, corroborated by the supplied Wano summary.

The abilities overview says the Wadatsumi roundhouse broke several fingers, while the specific technique entry says one finger. The discrepancy is preserved rather than resolved without further evidence.

Exact numerical technique multipliers, quantified ranges, resource costs and comprehensive weaknesses are not supplied. The Karate page's speculation based on tile counts is not treated as measurement; bodily-water attacks are not assumed to bypass every possible defense.

The abilities page asserts that Jinbe can secrete water, but provides no specific manga reference for that assertion. The detailed Karate page explicitly attributes secretion examples to Hody. Jinbe's self-generated water supply is therefore not established in this record.

Supreme King Haki, future sight, and advanced Armament emission or internal-destruction classifications are not established for Jinbe by the supplied evidence. Black lightning and the adjective 'advanced' are insufficient to assign those specific abilities.
No unsupported memory or caller-invented concept has been included. Navigation lists were not treated as proof that Jinbe possesses other listed characters' powers.
Some acquired sources are incomplete or unavailable.

Manga chapter references support the selected continuity; the supplied ONE PIECE.com Wano summary corroborates his formal arrival as a crewmate. Later material and other characters' abilities are excluded.

findings.message: Pulse and emission cycles count successful primary attack cycles required for one trigger, not waves per trigger. A cycle counts once when at least one primary hit applies positive damage, regardless of collateral targets. Pulses apply stun without damage; their event amount counts affected targets. Emissions apply their declared damage. Pulse intervals can further limit trigger frequency.

gaps: This is a bounded review of the supplied passages, not independent inspection of linked manga chapters, images or current websites. Later material within mixed-era passages was excluded.

The primary's inherent bodily-water penetration is represented only after internal-damage purchases. The base attack alone does not execute armor bypass; the source establishes the trait without that purchase requirement.

Buraikan retains concentrated damage and knockback but omits its gathered-water presentation and has no inherent armor-bypass field. Its reduced implementation should not be mistaken for a complete simulation of the sourced water technique.

The requested liquid throws and water distribution are absent, as expressly permitted when environmental water cannot be enforced. The implemented shoulder throw is bodily grappling, not a substitute claim that liquid manipulation is executable.

Defensive durability, Kairagi, Samehada Shotei, underwater enhancement, swimming, rescue movement, fish communication and transport, negotiation, blood transfusion and historical weapons remain explicit omissions, not implemented bonuses.

Damage, timing, reach, status duration, displacement, emission geometry, resource schedules and unlock progression are provisional game abstractions. The supplied evidence does not establish their exact values or measured balance.
